evidence: Eater: "Brooklyn's St. Anselm Reopens After a Fire" (Feb. 2025) — the Sept. 2024 fire closure was temporary and it reopened at 355 Metropolitan Ave.
Bakery's own site still lists the Chelsea shop at "236 9th Ave" with hours Monday-Sunday 8:00am-7:00pm and online ordering.
Official site is live and current: "139 Division Street, New York, NY 10002" with an active OpenTable booking link; no closure reporting found.
Resy still takes reservations at 119 Avenue A into 2026 and the Michelin Guide lists it; its earlier 9th Street space closed in 2021 but the current Avenue A location is open.
Eater: "the 10-seat Sushi Ichimura (412 Greenwich Street, near Laight Street) will close permanently" when Eiji Ichimura retires in mid-August 2025.
Reservation platform lists Sushi Noz at 181 E 78th St with bookable dates in 2026; no closure reporting found.
OpenTable profile for "Sushi on Me - Jackson Heights" (71-26 Roosevelt Ave) remains active and its menu listings are live; no closure report found.
Owner Krizette Woods testified before the NY City Council as "Owner of Sylvia's Restaurant" in April 2025, and online ordering at 328 Malcolm X Blvd is live.
Live delivery/ordering listings (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Toast) for the Flushing location at 39-16 Prince St and 2026 food-blog visits; no closure news found.
June 2026 Brooklyn Magazine piece still refers to Tania Apolinar and Gio Cervantes' "game-changing Taqueria Ramirez in Greenpoint" among their operating restaurants.
June 2025 Time Out and Aug. 2025 Eater coverage of the Thai Diner team's new Mommy Pai's project; Thai Diner at 186 Mott St is still listed by the Michelin Guide.
Eater: Koloman opened in Sept. 2022 in "what had been the Breslin"; Eater also reported the Breslin was rebranded as Breslin Burger in 2021 (Breslin Burger is gone too).
Resy shows bookable reservations at 295 Grand St into September 2026 and the Michelin Guide still lists The Four Horsemen.
Resy takes THE GRILL reservations at 99 E 52nd St for April 2026, and Major Food Group's site and the Michelin Guide still list it.
Eater: "The restaurant and bar will close down on March 28" 2021 as the NoMad Hotel shut for renovations; it never returned — the property reopened as The Ned NoMad with new restaurants.
Official site is live and current, listing "5 Mott Street" with daily hours, online ordering and catering; no closure reporting found.
No closure report and no recent confirmation of operation found; only stale Michelin Guide/OpenTable/aggregator listings for 192 Grand St, so status could not be verified.
Michelin Guide still lists Tong at 321 Starr St, live online-ordering pages exist, and a 2025 Crain's story describes it as the building's current "Michelin-endorsed Thai restaurant tenant."
Address 2483 Arthur Ave now appears as "Arthur Ave Crust & Kitchen" (same owners per listing text), so it is unclear whether Tony & Tina's closed or was merely rebranded.
Resy shows bookable Yakitori Torishin reservations at 362 W 53rd St for April 2026; no closure reporting found.
